feeds.title: Bryan on Scouting
feeds.description: Scouting magazine is the official resource for adult leaders and volunteers of Cub Scouts, Scouts BSA, and Venturers in the Boy Scouts of America. The official publication for adult volunteers in the Boy Scouts of America.

feeds.title: Scout Life Magazine
feeds.description: Play challenging online games, laugh at funny jokes, build amazing projects and find lots of fun at the online home of Scout Life, the official youth magazine for the Boy Scouts of America.

feeds.title: Cub Scout Ideas
feeds.description: Find Tips for Cub Scout Leaders & Parents. A Cub Scout leader helping other leaders and parents with fun, inexpensive, easy and creative ideas you can use immediately! Check out our website CubScoutIdeas.com for some great suggestions!

feeds.title: Scouter Mom
feeds.description: A web resource for Cub Scouts, Boy Scouts, and Venturers. Find ideas for program planning, games, projects, meeting plans, and other printable helps. I am a Cub Scout Den Leader, Boy Scout Assistant Scoutmaster, and Venturing Crew Advisor.

feeds.title: Scouting Wire
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates along with upcoming schedules of activities of Boy Scouts of America. Scouts BSA is a year-round program for boys and girls in fifth grade through high school that provides fun, adventure, learning, challenge, and responsibility to help them become the best version of themselves. If there's a story to support that initiative, Boy Scouts Of America will share it.

feeds.title: Girl Scouts
feeds.description: We Are Girl Scouts Girl Scouts bring their dreams to life and work together to build a better world. We are 2.5 million strong - more than 1.7 million girls and 750,000 adults who believe in the power of every G.I.R.L. (Go-getter, Innovator, Risk-taker, Leader) to change the world. Since 1912, we have built girls of courage, confidence, and character who make the world a better place. '

feeds.title: Sea Scouts BSA
feeds.description: Get the latest Sea Scout News on admissions and activities. Sea Scouting is America's premiere on the water high adventure and personal development program for over 100 years.

feeds.title: Scouting Newsroom
feeds.description: The Boy Scouts of America Scouting Newsroom is the official source for Boy Scout news, updates, and announcements. For more than a century, Scouts have served others at all times. In fact, the Boy Scouts of America was founded on the premise that to be a good citizen you must do for others.

feeds.title: We Own Adventure
feeds.description: Get the latest Scouting News for the DC Metro Area. National Capital Area Council (NCAC), BSA serves more than 58,000 boys and girls in the DC Metro Area, helping them develop character, citizenship, and physical fitness.

feeds.title: Girl Scouts GCNWI
feeds.description: Follow our blog for positive and engaging conversations about the many ways our organization builds girls of courage, confidence and character! Girl Scouts GCNWI aims to build girls of courage, confidence and character.

feeds.title: Cascade Pacific Council, Boy Scouts of America Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from Cascade Pacific Council, schedules, and more! Cascade Pacific Council, BSA guides nearly 8,000 girls and boys in 19 counties of NW Oregon and SW Washington. We offer an unparalleled program that teaches leadership and citizenship through fun and exciting adventures for the whole family.

feeds.title: Girl Scouts of Colorado
feeds.description: Information for Girl Scouts of Colorado members and volunteers. Girl Scouts can do anything and everything they set their hearts and minds to! You'll find it all here. From members sharing their adventures to Highest Award honorees describing their projects and news from council, cookie updates, travel opportunities, volunteer tips and much, much more.

feeds.title: Girl Scouts Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates on planned activities, adventures and more! Girl Scouts Carolinas Peaks to Piedmont (GSCP2P), is one of the 111 councils from across the nation that delivers the Girl Scout program, serves nearly 12,000 girls in central and western North Carolina.

feeds.title: A Scoutmaster's Blog
feeds.description: This is a online journal of a Boy Scout troop scoutmaster's point of view and thoughts on over 40 years as a Boy Scout Leader in central Minnesota. This site also serves as the home of the 'Melrose Scout Productions Podcast' which features Scouting related videos, and the 'Around The Scouting Campfire' audio podcast.

feeds.title: Scout Leader
feeds.description: Girl Scout Leader is a blog devoted to sharing activities for earning Daisy petals, Brownie Try Its and badges, Junior badges and more. I am a Girl Scout leader and teacher who loves to help others!

feeds.title: Most Casual Observer
feeds.description: Casual observations of a physicist and hiker.

feeds.title: Girl Scout with a Cause
feeds.description: I began this blog in the spring of 2014, and it's just a way for me to express my opinions, experiences, random thoughts, ideas, and memories about Girl Scouts. I also enjoy writing about the histories of Camp WaBak and Camp Mary Elizabeth, two longtime camps in the GSSC-MM council. I like OFFICIAL scarves too. My name is Amy (Moore) Brown, and in the 3rd grade in 1981, I joined Girl Scout Troop 20 in Athens, Georgia.

feeds.title: Gravesham Scouts Blog
feeds.description: Find out the latest news, blogs, and articles from Gravesham Scouts here. A great place to find out all the latest news.

feeds.title: Scouts Bsa Troop 614 Blog
feeds.description: Check out our blog for the latest news, activities and adventures. We are one of the only linked troops in Santa Cruz County (technically speaking, we are Troop 614 for boys and Troop 2614 for girls but we function as one). All boys and girls aged 11 to 18 are invited to join our troop.

feeds.title: Girl Scout History Project
feeds.description: Hi, I am Ann and I will introduce you to some of the millions of women who have worn similar uniforms, sung the same songs, and made the same promise for over 100 years. I hope today's Girl Scouts get a feeling of that sisterhood that they are now a part of. It is never too late to join. In addition to this blog, I also curate a series of digital archives that document Girl Scout programs past and present.

feeds.title: Boy Scout Troop 466 NCAC
feeds.description: Learn about our programs and activities in this blog. The official blog of Troop 466 (Potomac District, National Capital Area Council)

feeds.title: The Scout Association of Maldives Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from the association about camps, scouts, admissions, activities and adventures. Scouting was introduced to the Maldives nearly five decades ago. The Association was first registered in 20th January 1984 as the 'Maldives Boy Scout Association'. Later on the Association was renamed as 'The Scout Association of Maldives' in 14th January 1994.

feeds.title: Scout Spirit Blog
feeds.description: Keep up-to-date on everything happening with the Spirit of Adventure Council! The Boy Scouts of America provides youth with programs and activities that allow them to Try new things, Provide service to others, Build self-confidence, Reinforce ethical standards.

feeds.title: SM Thoughts
feeds.description: Thoughts from the Scoutmaster on Scouting stories, skits, songs, games, graces, recipes, activities, ceremonies, and even a contest each month! This site began as a way to chronicle the experiences of one small group of cub scouts in Minnesota on their trail from tiger to eagle scouts. We documented our program schedules, advancements achieved, most all of our activities, games played, and skits performed. But, as things tend to evolve, we added more ideas that we thought would be fun to try some day.

feeds.title: High Adventure Scouting Blog
feeds.description: Blog with High Adventure Resources for Scouts and Scouters. The information contained in this website was designed out of necessity on the part of our Scout Troop. The goal is to offer groups more access to high adventure that will help guide youth into their adult lives.

feeds.title: Scout Pioneering
feeds.description: Learn more about pioneering, basic survival skills and more! Pioneering is all about using basic and advanced Scout skills to make life in the outdoors easier, and for having just plain ol' fashioned FUN!

feeds.title: Girl Scouts of Western Ohio
feeds.description: The purpose of this blog is to support volunteers as they implement the Girl Scout Leadership Experience with girls. We'll offer hands on activities to try with girls, tips and tricks to a support your work, and links to other helpful resources. Stay tuned!

feeds.title: GSCCC
feeds.description: Girl Scouts of California's Central Coast serves Santa Cruz, Monterey, San Benito, San Luis Obispo, Santa Barbara, and Ventura counties. Building Girls of courage, confidence, and character.

feeds.title: Kevin Devin
feeds.description: This is a site about the Devin family. Explore the blog to follow their adventures as scouts.

feeds.title: Scouting Montana
feeds.description: Follow the blog to receive updates about the Montana Council, activities, adventures and more! The mission of the Montana Council is to help young people make ethical and moral decisions over their lifetimes by instilling in them the values of the Scout Oath and Scout Law.

feeds.title: Bobwhite Blather
feeds.description: Here on these pages, you will find my observations about Boy Scouting, both in situations I've encountered and topics I've discussed with others. I'll also include topics from Roundtable sessions and breakouts that I've conducted and classes I've developed for University of Scouting. A blog for Scouters offering information, observation and inspiration.

feeds.title: Catholic Scouting Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates along with stories of activities and more in the blog. Catholic Scouting is an official program of the Catholic Church in the United States, with religious programming approved by the Church.
